children: The major US stock indexes gave back their gains shortly after market open on Friday, with tech stocks under renewed pressure as investors fretted over the potential fallout of the controversy surrounding Nvidia.
Data that showed October producer prices were slightly softer than expected, did little to ease sentiment.
At 10:08 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average
fell 96.34 points, or 0.18%, to 52,200.75, the S&P 500
lost 53.03 points, or 0.70%, to 7,539.37, and the Nasdaq Composite
Declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 1.28-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.75-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq.
